spec.description:
Foilboard Blank Plates are lightweight, rigid spreading washers
designed to distribute screw and fastener loads over Foilboard rigid insulation
boards without crushing the expanded polystyrene (EPS) core. Manufactured from
high-impact polymer or sheet metal, they feature pre-punched center holes that
accommodate standard wood screws, self-drilling metal tek screws, or masonry
anchors. By creating a broad clamping surface, they prevent fastener heads from
pulling through the aluminum foil facing during wind load or structural
vibration.
features:
Distributes fastening pressure over a broad surface
area to prevent panel crushing

Stops screw heads from tearing through the
outer aluminum foil laminate

Pre-punched center hole to fit standard screws,
nails, and anchors

Constructed from durable, corrosion-resistant, high-impact
polymer or metal

Lightweight, rigid, and fast to position during
installation

Compatible with all Foilboard panel thicknesses from 10mm
to 50mm
Ideal for walls, ceilings, and underfloor applications
spec.fire:
Non-combustible metal or low-hazard polymer;
compatible with NCC fire compliance systems
spec.compliance:
AS/NZS 4859.1,
AS 3999, NCC Volume One and Two
install:
Position Foilboard panel in place against framing or
masonry substrate

Insert screw, nail, or anchor through the center hole of
the Foilboard Blank Plate

Drive fastener through the Foilboard panel into
timber, steel, or masonry framing

Tighten until the Blank Plate rests snug
and flat against the aluminum foil facing

Do not over-torque to avoid
compressing the underlying EPS core

Place Blank Plates at recommended spacing
(typically 600mm centers along edges and center)

Cover plate and fastener
head with Foilboard 72mm reinforced foil tape if an airtight vapor seal is
required
selection_checklist:
Confirm fastener screw length
accommodates panel thickness plus substrate embedment

Calculate quantity
needed based on approx. 6-8 plates per 2440x1200mm board

Choose polymer or
galvanized plate based on substrate and environmental exposure

Order
matching 72mm foil tape to seal over screw heads
limitations:
Do not over-tighten fasteners as excessive torque
will deform the panel core

Blank Plates do not provide thermal break values
on their own

Not designed to support heavy structural cladding loads
independently

problem_keywords: fastener heads crushing the EPS core under wind pressure
use_cases: Fixing Foilboard sheets to garage ceilings or shed framing using tek screws
Securing Foilboard panels to timber or steel wall studs without crushing the EPS core
Spreading mechanical clamping force when fastening Foilboard to masonry walls
retrieval.rag_summary:
Foilboard
Blank Plates are rigid 40mm x 40mm spreader plates engineered to distribute
fastening loads when securing Foilboard insulation boards to timber, steel, or
masonry framing. Pre-punched to accept standard construction screws and nails,
they prevent fasteners from crushing the EPS core or tearing through the
reflective aluminum facing. They ensure solid mechanical fixing across wall,
ceiling, and underfloor applications without compromising panel integrity.
